blocking_findings.title: Publish observed exit sentinels atomically
blocking_findings.finding: observed_child writes directly to the final .exit path. This bypasses the charter's required temporary write, close, integer readback validation and atomic publication. A write interruption can expose an empty/incomplete public sentinel. No observed false PASS is claimed.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Use a fresh temporary exit file, flush/fsync, close, explicitly validate exact decimal exit/newline and equality to observed returncode, publish atomically without overwriting a preexisting destination, and verify published bytes before receipt binding. Update standalone cell/notebook/hashes as a distinct immutable repair and add targeted Linux failure/interruption/duplicate-path checks.
